 Karl-Anthony Towns (wrist) listed probable Friday 
 by Ari Koslow | Knicks Correspondent | Fri, Oct 30th 2026, 4:26pm EDT 
 Karl-Anthony Towns is listed as probable for Friday's game against the 76ers. ( NBA Injury Report ) 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Towns sprained his left wrist in the first quarter of Wednesday’s win over the Bulls. He was able to finish the game, and he is on track to being good to go on Friday.
